TI.P: on the position to be adopted, on behalf of the European Union, in the EEA Joint Committee concerning an amendment to Annex XIII to the EEA Agreement

PREAMBLE.PREAMBLE.INIT: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,

GR.VISA.VISA: Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, and in particular Article 100(2), in conjunction with Article 218(9) thereof,

Having regard to Council Regulation (EC) No 2894/94 of28 November 1994concerning arrangements for implementing the Agreement on the European Economic Area
OJ L 305, 30.11.1994, p. 6. , and in particular Article 1(3) thereof,
Having regard to the proposal from the European Commission,

NP.TXT:
The Agreement on the European Economic Area
OJ L 1, 3.1.1994, p. 3. ( the EEA Agreement ) entered into force on1 January 1994.
Pursuant to Article 98 of the EEA Agreement, the EEA Joint Committee may decide to amend, inter alia, Annex XIII thereto.
Annex XIII to the EEA Agreement contains specific provisions on all modes of transport.

Regulation (EC) No 1070/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of21 October 2009amending Regulations (EC) No 549/2004, (EC) No 550/2004, (EC) No 551/2004 and (EC) No 552/2004 in order to improve the performance and sustainability of the European aviation system
OJ L 300, 14.11.2009, p. 34. is to be incorporated into the EEA Agreement with certain adaptations for the EEA EFTA States.

The adaptations for the EEA EFTA States concern the applicability of the amendments inserted by Regulation (EC) No 1070/2009 in Articles 5, 11 and 13a of Regulation (EC) No 549/2004
OJ L 96, 31.3.2004, p. 1. , Article 9a(2)(c), Article 9a(2)(i) and Article 9a(5) and (6) of Regulation (EC) No 550/2004
OJ L 96, 31.3.2004, p. 10. and Article 6(2) of Regulation (EC) No 551/2004
OJ L 96, 31.3.2004, p. 20. .
Annex XIII to the EEA Agreement should therefore be amended accordingly.
The position of the Union in the EEA Joint Committee should be based on the attached draft Decision,

ARTICLE.ALINEA: The position to be adopted, on behalf of the European Union, in the EEA Joint Committee on the proposed amendment to Annex XIII to the EEA Agreement shall be based on the draft Decision of the EEA Joint Committee attached to this Decision.
This Decision shall enter into force on the day of its adoption.
